title: Minimum Benefit for Families Act of 1991
short_title: Minimum Benefit for Families Act of 1991

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.

summaries.text: Minimum Benefit for Families Act of 1991 - Amends part A (Aid to Families with Dependent Children) (AFDC) of title IV of the Social Security Act to establish minimum AFDC payment standards for State plans under which AFDC payments, when combined with food stamp benefits, must at least equal 50 percent of the applicable poverty level for the size of the family involved.
